name: Williams College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students, guaranteed for four years
dlText: Regular Decision ~8 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Around 70% of Williams' international students receive college aid. If you don't apply for aid with your admission application you can never get it later. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Swarthmore College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of need up to full tuition, fees, housing, food, books and some personal costs; no loans
dlText: Regular Decision 4 Jan 2027 (time not stated); decisions by 1 Apr
tags: Aid forms within 7 days of admission
note: Swarthmore meets full need regardless of citizenship, but applying for aid puts international applicants in the most selective group. International students send aid documents within 7 days of their admission offer.

name: Pomona College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students; no loans
dlText: Regular Decision ~8 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: About 40–50% of Pomona's incoming international students get need-based aid. An international student who enrols without having applied for aid can't receive it later. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Wesleyan University need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students who requested aid
dlText: Regular Decision ~1 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Wesleyan says aid for international applicants is limited, so admission for them is extremely selective. If you don't ask for aid before admission you can't get it during your four years. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Grinnell College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students, mostly grants; no loans
dlText: Regular Decision ~15 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: You must file the 2027–28 CSS Profile or Grinnell's International Student Application for Financial Assistance by your round's deadline. Offers are final: no appeals, and you can't apply after you enrol. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Vassar College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students who applied for aid
dlText: Regular Decision ~1 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Vassar admits roughly 35–45 aided international students each year from 850+ who apply. You must apply for aid together with your admission application. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Colby College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students; no loans
dlText: Regular Decision ~4 Jan 2027 (Colby's pages also say 2 Jan; time not stated); aid forms 15 Jan
note: Colby builds international aid packages without loans for up to four years. Colby's pages give the Regular Decision deadline as both 2 and 4 Jan, so check before you apply.

name: Middlebury College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full demonstrated need of admitted international students (grants, work and a limited loan)
dlText: Regular Decision ~3 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Middlebury says it is need-aware for international applicants but meets full need once you are admitted. Its new tuition-free promise for families earning up to $175,000 (from fall 2027) doesn't say whether it covers internationals. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Davidson College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of calculated need for admitted international students
dlText: Regular Decision ~11 Jan 2027 (date from Davidson's current timeline page, may be last cycle; time not stated)
note: Students who have already enrolled at another college are not eligible for aid. Families expecting to contribute under US$5,000/year can use Davidson's International Financial Verification Form instead of the CSS Profile.

name: Wellesley College need-based aid (international)
amount: Funds 100% of calculated need for admitted international students (travel not included)
dlText: Regular Decision ~8 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Wellesley has a limited number of need-based awards for international students, so admission with aid is highly competitive. Aid given at admission doesn't need to be reapplied for each year. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Smith College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full documented need of admitted students who apply by the deadlines; loan-free
dlText: Regular Decision ~15 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: International students who don't apply for aid by the published deadlines before admission can never get college aid. Smith's Next 150 Pledge (from fall 2026) gives free tuition to students who qualify financially. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Bryn Mawr College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full demonstrated need of admitted students (Bryn Mawr grant; international loan may be included)
dlText: Regular Decision 15 Jan 2027 (time not stated)
note: Aid money runs out in order, so asking for aid can decide whether you're admitted. International students are not eligible for merit aid.

name: Stanford need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full demonstrated need for admitted students who requested aid, regardless of citizenship
dlText: Regular Decision ~5 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Asking for aid makes admission more selective for international citizens, and about one in three international students get aid. If admitted without requesting aid, you can't apply later. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Columbia need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for four years with grants and work-study; no loans
dlText: Regular Decision ~1 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Columbia is not need-blind for international students but admits many with substantial aid. If you are admitted without requesting aid you can't switch later. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: UChicago need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international first-years; grants, no loans
dlText: Regular Decision ~5 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: You must apply for aid during the admissions process; there are no exceptions after decisions. Partial merit scholarships also exist but shouldn't be relied on. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Duke need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for eight semesters for a limited number of international students
dlText: Regular Decision ~2 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Duke expects to enrol only 20–25 international students a year with full need met, and international transfers can't get aid. Aided internationals don't reapply each year. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Brown need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students who apply for aid
dlText: Regular Decision ~3 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Since the Class of 2029, Brown admits international first-year applicants without regard to ability to pay. You must apply for aid at the same time you apply for admission. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Penn need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants and work-study; no loans
dlText: Regular Decision ~5 Jan 2027 (estimated from previous cycles; time not stated)
note: Penn is need-blind only for US, Canadian and Mexican citizens; for other international applicants available aid is considered. Part of a grant may be subject to US tax. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Northwestern University need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international first-years with grants (no loans), for four years
dlText: Regular Decision ~2 Jan 2027, 11:59 pm local time (estimated from 2026 cycle); CSS Profile due ~1 Feb
tags: Must tick aid box when applying
note: International students who don't request aid at application can never receive need-based aid later; no aid for international transfers. Regular Decision date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Vanderbilt University need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants/scholarships for a limited number of admitted international first-years
dlText: Regular Decision application ~1 Jan 2027 (not confirmed on an official page; estimated); RD aid forms (CSS Profile/ISFAA) due 1 Feb 2027
note: International transfer applicants requesting aid are not considered. Separate merit scholarships (Ingram, Cornelius Vanderbilt) are due 1 Dec 2026.

name: Rice University need-based aid (international)
amount: International students who receive need-based aid have 100% of demonstrated need met with institutional grants (not part of the Rice Investment)
dlText: Regular Decision ~4 Jan 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle; time not stated); aid priority date ~1 Feb
tags: CSS Profile + International Student Financial Statement
note: Aid goes to a limited number of international first-years and must be requested on the admission application; no aid for international transfers. Date estimated from 2026 cycle.

name: Washington University in St. Louis need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international first-year students
dlText: Regular Decision 4 Jan 2027 (per official how-to-apply page; time not stated); aid due 1 Feb
note: WashU's need-blind policy excludes international applicants, but it meets 100% of need for those admitted. Submit the CSS Profile by the aid deadline.

name: Carleton College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need; loans to be replaced by grants from 2027–28
dlText: Regular Decision & aid ~15 Jan 2027 (estimated from current cycle; time not stated)
note: Most international aid is awarded in Regular Decision; aid requests are not considered after an admission offer. Cost of attendance 2026–27 about $104,746.

name: Hamilton College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full demonstrated need of every admitted international student for four years
dlText: Regular Decision aid deadline 15 Jan 2027 (time not stated)
note: Aid applications are not accepted after admission decisions; you must apply for aid at the time of admission.

name: Haverford College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full demonstrated need of all admitted students, including international students (limited number per class)
dlText: Regular Decision aid deadline 10 Jan 2027 (time not stated)
tags: Small number of intl aid places
note: Only a small number of international students per class get aid; no aid for international transfers. Aid does not cover travel or living costs when college is not in session.

name: Colgate University need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of every admitted international student's demonstrated need (no merit scholarships)
dlText: Regular Decision & CSS Profile ~15 Jan 2027 (estimated from current cycle; one page says 22 Jan; time not stated)
note: Colgate offers need-based aid only. Official pages give both 15 and 22 Jan for the CSS Profile; use the earlier date.

name: Bates College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full calculated need for all admitted students regardless of citizenship; grant + on-campus job, no loans for non-US citizens
dlText: Regular Decision ~10 Jan 2027 (estimated from current cycle; time not stated)
note: Request aid before your admission decision is released. Package is the same whichever round you are admitted in.

name: Macalester College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students, including international students
dlText: Regular Decision aid deadline 22 Jan (current-cycle official page; time not stated)
note: Because of budget limits, applicants with the highest need face the most competition; aid can't be requested after the admission decision.

name: Trinity College (Hartford) need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets full demonstrated need of admitted students (limited number of international awards)
dlText: Regular Decision ~15 Jan 2027 (estimated; another official page says 17 Jan; time not stated)
note: Aid may include scholarships, grants and loans. Official pages disagree on 15 vs 17 Jan; use the earlier date.

name: Berea College international student aid
amount: Aid and scholarships cover 100% of tuition, housing, food and fees for admitted international students
dlText: ~30 Nov 2026 (international application deadline; the official page gives no year, so this is an estimate; time not stated)
tags: Full cost covered for all admitted intl students
note: Berea charges no tuition and covers housing, food and fees for internationals; all application parts are due by 30 Nov, decisions mid-March.

name: Donald A. Wehrung International Student Award (UBC International Scholars)
amount: Need-based; typically covers full tuition and living costs, renewable
dlText: 15 Nov 2026, 11:59 pm PT (International Scholars Program application)
tags: From war-torn/unstable or economically disadvantaged region
note: Applied for through UBC's International Scholars Program (same application as the Karen McKellin award). Award size is set by individual need.

name: President's International Scholarship of Excellence
amount: CA$180,000 over 4 years (CA$45,000/year)
dlText: 27 Jan 2027, 11:59 pm EST (student application); nomination & reference by 4 Feb 2027
note: For high-school students entering first year at York in Fall 2027; cannot be combined with entrance scholarships. Apply to York early so your admission application is in on time.
